user.title: Connect ScaleVault
user.description: Paste the API key generated in ScaleVault under Account Settings → Integrations.

advanced_options.name: Advanced
advanced_options.description: Only needed when testing against a dev/staging server.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect ScaleVault
reauth_confirm.description: ScaleVault rejected the stored API key. Paste a new one generated under Account Settings → Integrations.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the URL and that ScaleVault is reachable.

abort.already_configured: This ScaleVault account is already configured.

user.title: Add a sensor mapping
user.description: Pick a temperature/humidity sensor to forward to ScaleVault, and optionally which enclosure it belongs to. State changes are batched and pushed roughly once a minute.{climate_history_status}

reconfigure.title: Edit sensor mapping
reconfigure.description: Change which sensor forwards, or which enclosure it maps to.{climate_history_status}

abort.already_configured: This sensor already has a ScaleVault mapping.

log_feeding.name: Log feeding
log_feeding.description: Log a feeding in ScaleVault. Additive only — creates a new record, never edits or deletes one.

target.name: Target
target.description: Animal code (e.g. A-0001) or enclosure code (e.g. E-0004) — a single-animal enclosure resolves to that animal automatically. Use "all" to feed every animal in the account. Leave blank to use the "Feeding target" select entity's current pick.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Optional note to attach to the log entry.

log_watering.name: Log water check
log_watering.description: Log a water check in ScaleVault. Additive only — creates a new record, never edits or deletes one.

target.name: Target
target.description: Enclosure code (e.g. E-0004). Use "all" to apply to every enclosure in the account. Leave blank to use the "Enclosure target" select entity's current pick.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Optional note to attach to the log entry.

log_cleaning.name: Log cleaning
log_cleaning.description: Log a cleaning in ScaleVault. Additive only — creates a new record, never edits or deletes one.

target.name: Target
target.description: Enclosure code (e.g. E-0004). Use "all" to apply to every enclosure in the account. Leave blank to use the "Enclosure target" select entity's current pick.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Optional note to attach to the log entry.

log_action.name: Log action key
log_action.description: Trigger an action key configured in ScaleVault under Settings → Home Assistant, instead of a fixed action/target. What the key actually does (which action(s), which target(s)) is edited there, not here. A key can map to more than one action and/or target; ScaleVault performs every combination and this service raises an error naming any that failed.

key.name: Key
key.description: The action key's name, as configured in ScaleVault.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Optional note to attach to the log entry(ies). Overrides the key's configured notes, if any.
